headlines.title: Insmed to Present New Data Across Its Respiratory Portfolio at CHEST 2026 and IDWeek 2026
headlines.summary: Insmed Incorporated (Nasdaq: INSM), a people-first global biopharmaceutical company striving to deliver first- and best-in-class therapies to transform the lives of patients facing serious diseases, today announced new data from its respiratory portfolio will be presented at the American College of Chest Physicians® Annual Meeting 2026 (CHEST 2026), taking place Oct. 18–21 in Phoenix, and IDWeek 2026, taking place Oct. 21–24 in Washington, D.C.

headlines.title: Does Insmed (INSM) CFO Exit With Reaffirmed Guidance Clarify Or Complicate Its Growth Narrative?
headlines.summary: Insmed Incorporated announced that Chief Financial Officer Sara Bonstein will step down after the company reported its third-quarter 2026 results and reaffirmed its full-year 2026 revenue guidance for BRINSUPRI® (brensocatib) of US$1.25 billion to US$1.40 billion and for ARIKAYCE® of US$450 million to US$470 million.

headlines.title: INSM Stock Slides on CFO Exit, Reiterates '26 Sales View
headlines.summary: Insmed shares slide after CFO Sara Bonstein's surprise exit, though the company reaffirms 2026 revenue guidance for Brinsupri and Arikayce.

headlines.title: Insmed stock falls as CFO Sara Bonstein to step down
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Insmed Inc (NASDAQ:INSM) shares fell 8% Monday after the company announced Chief Financial Officer Sara Bonstein will step down on October 30.

headlines.title: Insmed Announces CFO Transition
headlines.summary: Insmed Incorporated (Nasdaq: INSM), a people-first global biopharmaceutical company striving to deliver first- and best-in-class therapies to transform the lives of patients facing serious diseases, today announced that Sara Bonstein will step down as Chief Financial Officer (CFO). description: Insmed Incorporated develops and commercializes therapies for patients with serious and rare diseases in the United States, Europe, Japan, and internationally. The company offers ARIKAYCE for the treatment of refractory nontuberculous mycobacterial lung infections, as well as is in phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of mycobacterium avium complex lung disease as part of a combination antibacterial drug regimen for adult patients. It also develops brensocatib, an oral reversible inhibitor of dipeptidyl peptidase 1(DPP1) that is in phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of bronchiectasis; and in phase 2 clinical trial for the treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis without nasal polyps and hidradenitis suppurativa. In addition, the company is developing treprostinil palmitil inhalation powder, an inhaled formulation of a treprostinil prodrug treprostinil palmitil, which is in phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease; and phase 2 clinical trial for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension. Further, it develops INS1201, a microdystrophin adeno-associated virus gene replacement therapy which is in phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy, as well as it is also developing pre-clinical research programs for gene therapy, AI-driven protein engineering, protein manufacturing, RNA end-joining, and synthetic rescue. In addition, it provides INS1148, monoclonal antibody targeting stem cell factor called SCF248 that is in phase-2 clinical trial for the treatment of interstitial lung disease, and asthma; and INS1202, an intrathecally delivered gene therapy which is in phase 1 of clinical trial for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.  The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey.
